#!/bin/sh
cd ${0%/*} || exit 1    # run from this directory

# -- run the calc
# the debug flag writes each intermediate refinement set
blastEquation \
    -fx "sqr(x - 3) - 2" \
    -minimize "(-5 5)"\
    -findAllRoots "(-5 5)" \
    -integrate "(-1 1)" > log.function

blastEquation \
    -P "(4.2 7 3.1 2)" \
    -findPolyRoots \
    -integrate "(-2.3 0.45)" > log.polynomial
